title: App store: add + create project workspace
description: addProjectWorkspace in app-store-workspace.ts: validates root path, calls syncWorkspace, stores projectKey+repoPaths. IPC handler workspaces:addProject + preload api.addProjectWorkspace. Extend startThread/createWorktree: when environment===worktree AND workspace has repoPaths, use MultiRepoWorktreeManager instead of GitWorktreeManager. Single-repo flow unaffected. Acceptance: project workspace in sidebar, worktree creation makes N linked git worktrees.

title: UI: Multi-repo indicators in sidebar
description: Project workspaces in sidebar.tsx get repo-stack icon/badge + N repos count. Worktree entries under project show multi-repo tag. No layout changes for single-repo. Reuse icons.tsx patterns, no new deps. Acceptance: project workspace visually distinct from single-repo at a glance.

title: MultiRepoWorktreeManager
description: New class electron/multi-repo-worktree-manager.ts. createWorktreeSet(project, branchName) creates worktrees at ~/.worktrees/{project}/{branch}/{repo}/ concurrently, rolls back on partial failure, returns {rootPath, paths}. removeWorktreeSet gracefully handles missing. sanitizeBranchForPath helper. Reuses GitWorktreeManager per repo. Acceptance: parallel creation, clean rollback on error.

title: Epic: Multi-repo worktree support
description: Add multi-repo project support to pi-gui desktop. A project is a named set of repos (root + subrepos, as defined in ~/.config/singularity/projects.json). When creating a worktree for a project workspace, all repos get a linked git worktree at ~/.worktrees/{project}/{branch}/{repo}/. Multiple agents can run per worktree (already supported via multiple sessions). This epic covers the full vertical slice from config reading to UX.

title: UI: Add project workspace modal
description: New src/add-project-modal.tsx. Triggered from sidebar as Add project option. Calls api.listProjects() on mount. Shows projects: name + repo count. On select calls api.addProjectWorkspace(projectKey). Loading/error states. If projects.json missing: helpful message. Acceptance: user can add project workspace in under 3 clicks.

title: Session context injection + worktree progress UI
description: 1) Session context: when starting session in project worktree, inject subrepo paths as context (system prompt or context_files). Format: This is a multi-repo project. Sub-repo worktree paths: - pbd-api: path. Must not affect single-repo sessions. 2) Progress UI: spinner or inline indicator during multi-repo worktree creation showing Creating worktrees for N repos. On error show which repos failed. Acceptance: agent sees subrepo paths in context; user sees feedback within 500ms of creating worktrees.

title: Desktop state types for multi-repo
description: Extend TS types: WorkspaceKind add project. WorkspaceRecord add optional projectKey and repoPaths. New types ProjectConfig/ProjectDef/RepoDef. CreateProjectWorkspaceInput and CreateProjectWorktreeInput types. Acceptance: types compile, no behavior change to existing single-repo flow.

title: Project config reader
description: Read ~/.config/singularity/projects.json and expose via IPC. New module electron/project-config.ts. Reads ProjectConfig {projects: {[key]: {name, repos: [{name, path, default_branch}]}}}. Expands ~ in paths. Falls back gracefully when file missing. IPC channel projects:list. Preload api.listProjects(). Acceptance: listProjects() returns parsed config; missing file returns empty projects map.
